criteria.requirement: Implement marshmallow.normalized.NormalizedString as a String field with keyword form="NFC" (NFC/NFD/NFKC/NFKD/None), strip=True and casefold=False, preserving standard field kwargs. Deserialize using the real String conversion, optionally strip then casefold then normalize before normal Field validators and post-load hooks. Preserve allow_none/missing/default/data_key/required behavior, original bytes validation, dump behavior and other String fields. Reject invalid policies at construction and retain independent per-schema field copies.
